name: nofax
description: Local human-in-the-loop notifications, approval requests, choices, and refinement via a configured ntfy transport.
long_description: Nofax runs locally over MCP and sends explicitly requested notifications through your configured ntfy service. Interactive requests remain pending until a matching terminal response is received. It does not replace Claude or operating-system permission controls and installs no hooks. Configure Nofax first using the documented CLI quick start. Public ntfy is not end-to-end encrypted; avoid sensitive material and use a trusted transport. Local request state stays in your Nofax home directory.

tools.name: nofax_notify
tools.description: Send a one-way phone notification. This tool is informational and does not create a human-response wait. Notification transport success never counts as approval.

tools.name: nofax_request_approval
tools.description: Send Allow/Deny to the phone and return a durable pending requestId. IMPORTANT: after this tool returns pending, call nofax_wait_for_response and repeat while it remains pending. Never continue the guarded action without a terminal Allow response. Set allowRefine when the human should also be able to send refinement text.

tools.name: nofax_request_choice
tools.description: Send up to three explicit options to the phone and return a durable pending requestId. IMPORTANT: call nofax_wait_for_response and repeat while pending; do not choose on the human's behalf.

tools.name: nofax_request_refinement
tools.description: Ask the human for free-text refinement through the configured Nofax Refine iOS Shortcut. Use this when free-text edits are needed; use nofax_request_approval for Allow/Deny or nofax_request_choice for predefined options. Returns a durable pending requestId; call nofax_wait_for_response and repeat while pending.

tools.name: nofax_wait_for_response
tools.description: Long-poll a durable Nofax request for up to 240 seconds. If the result is pending, you MUST call this tool again with the same requestId. Repeat indefinitely until a terminal response is returned or the user explicitly changes/cancels the goal. Do not continue the guarded action while pending.

tools.name: nofax_get_request
tools.description: Inspect safe metadata and terminal state for one known durable requestId without waiting. Use nofax_wait_for_response when the caller must wait for a human decision, or nofax_list_pending to recover requestIds after interruption. Secret response topics are never returned.

tools.name: nofax_list_pending
tools.description: List a bounded set of unresolved Nofax request handles for recovery after client or conversation interruption. Secret response topics are never returned.
